textPrompt: Create an extraordinary, visually captivating 10-slide PowerPoint presentation titled 'BEYOND EARTH: Space Exploration and the Future of Humanity'. Target scientists, students, technology enthusiasts and investors. Produce exactly ten slides covering: an impressive space-themed cover; the history of space exploration; major milestones in human spaceflight; the International Space Station; robotic exploration of Mars; discoveries from space telescopes; modern rocket and spacecraft technology; the search for habitable worlds; challenges of long-duration space missions; and the future of space exploration. Use a cinematic color palette of midnight black, deep navy, cosmic purple, electric blue and white, with subtle gold accents. Incorporate spectacular, scientifically relevant space imagery including planets, galaxies, spacecraft, astronauts, rockets and telescope observations. Use authentic space photography where available, with clear distinctions between real observations and artistic concepts. Maintain consistent heading and body font sizes across all slides, elegant typography, excellent contrast, attractive spacing and varied professional layouts. Avoid empty slides, unrelated images, repetitive designs, excessive text, unsupported scientific claims and technical image-generation labels displayed as decorative text. Ensure exactly ten slides are generated and all images are properly embedded in the PPTX and visible in PDF and PNG previews. The presentation must look polished enough for an international science and technology conference.
